title: User Authentication Success
description: Verify that users can login successfully with valid credentials and access the dashboard with appropriate role-based permissions.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input valid username and password.
Complete multi-factor authentication if enabled.
Click login button.
Verify user is redirected to dashboard.
Verify dashboard content is displayed according to user's role permissions.

title: User Authentication Failure - Invalid Credentials
description: Verify system denies access and displays appropriate error on login attempt with invalid credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Input invalid username or password.
Click login button.
Verify login is denied and error message is displayed.
Verify no dashboard or protected content is accessible.

title: Dashboard Module Accessibility by Role
description: Verify that all dashboard modules (25+) are accessible or restricted correctly based on different user roles.

steps.description: Login as clinic staff with limited role.
Verify only authorized modules are accessible.
Logout and login as practice manager.
Verify expanded set of modules accessible.
Logout and login as admin user.
Verify all dashboard modules are accessible.

title: Client and Patient CRUD Operations
description: Verify creating, reading, updating and deleting client owners and their patients including multi-pet households with detailed medical histories.

steps.description: Navigate to Clients module.
Create a new client owner with valid data.
Verify client is listed and details are correct.
Add multiple patient records for the client.
Verify patient list shows all pets with correct details.
Update patient medical history including vaccination status.
Verify medical history changes are saved and displayed.
Delete a patient record.
Verify patient is removed from the list.
Delete the client owner record.
Verify client and all associated patients are deleted.

title: Appointment Scheduling with Conflict Detection and Recurrence
description: Verify appointment creation, editing, conflict detection, recurring booking and automated reminders.

steps.description: Open Appointments module.
Create an appointment at a selected date/time.
Verify appointment appears correctly on calendar.
Attempt to schedule another appointment for the same resource and time.
Verify system detects conflict and prevents double booking.
Create a recurring appointment series.
Verify all recurring instances appear on calendar.
Edit or cancel a single instance of recurring appointments.
Verify calendar and appointment data are updated correctly.
Verify automated reminders are sent in expected timeframe by email/SMS.

title: Clinical Records SOAP Note Entry and Prescription Tracking
description: Verify creation and editing of clinical records following SOAP format, including prescriptions and diagnostic results.

steps.description: Open Clinical Records module.
Create a new clinical record using SOAP note structure.
Add prescription details and attach diagnostic results.
Verify the record saves successfully and displays all entered data correctly.
Edit SOAP note entries and update prescriptions.
Verify changes are saved and reflected accurately.
Test clinical record search and retrieval.
Verify correct clinical records are returned based on patient and date filters.

title: Inventory and Vaccination Stock Tracking with Alerts
description: Verify inventory item CRUD, stock level tracking, low stock alerts, vaccination record and protocol management.

steps.description: Navigate to Inventory module.
Add new inventory item with quantity and expiration.
Verify item appears in inventory list with correct details.
Reduce stock level to below configured threshold.
Verify low stock alert notification is triggered and visible.
Navigate to Vaccinations module.
Add vaccination records for patients including protocols.
Verify vaccination data is accurately stored and accessible.

title: Billing and Invoice Generation with Payment Processing
description: Verify invoice creation, multiple payment methods processing, insurance claim integration, and financial reporting.

steps.description: Open Billing module.
Create a new invoice with multiple billed items and services.
Verify invoice total and itemization are accurate.
Process payment with credit card.
Verify payment is recorded and invoice updates to paid status.
Submit insurance claim for eligible invoice.
Verify insurance claim processing and status update.
Generate financial reports covering revenue and outstanding invoices.
Verify report data accuracy and completeness.

title: Communications Center - Email and SMS Messaging with Templates
description: Verify sending messages via email and SMS using templates, logging all client interactions, and maintaining message history for audit.

steps.description: Open Communications module.
Select client and prepare message using email template.
Send email message and verify delivery status.
Verify message log contains the sent email with correct details.
Prepare SMS message using template.
Send SMS to client and verify delivery.
Verify SMS message log records the communication.
Search message history by client and date.
Verify message history returns all relevant messages.

title: Boarding and Hospitalization Reservation Management
description: Verify reservation creation, check-in/check-out processes, medical monitoring integration, and billing association for boarding patients.

steps.description: Navigate to Boarding module.
Create reservation for boarding including patient and date range.
Verify reservation details saved and status is 'Reserved'.
Perform patient check-in.
Verify status updates to 'Checked-in'.
Log daily medical monitoring entries.
Verify medical data is linked to reservation.
Perform patient check-out.
Verify status updates to 'Checked-out' and reservation closes.
Verify boarding charges are added to billing system.

title: Task and Reminder Management
description: Verify creating, assigning, updating, and tracking tasks with priorities, statuses, automated reminders, and team collaboration.

steps.description: Open Tasks module.
Create a new task with high priority and assign to team member.
Verify task is listed with correct details and assigned user.
Update task status to 'In Progress' then 'Completed'.
Verify status updates persist and notifications are triggered.
Configure automated reminder for task due date.
Verify reminder notifications are sent to assigned user at appropriate time.

title: Staff Time Tracking and Attendance Reporting
description: Verify clock in/out, break tracking, overtime calculation, and accurate generation of attendance reports integrated with payroll.

steps.description: Login as staff user.
Use time tracking tool to clock in at start of shift.
Verify clock-in time is recorded.
Record breaks and clock out at end of shift.
Verify break durations and clock-out time are recorded.
Calculate overtime if shift exceeds scheduled hours.
Verify overtime hours are correctly computed.
Generate attendance report for staff for specified period.
Verify report includes accurate work hours, breaks, and overtime.

title: Performance Benchmark Testing
description: Verify that page loads are under 2 seconds and API responses under 500ms under typical load conditions.

steps.description: Simulate typical user load on dashboard and modules.
Measure page load times across key modules.
Verify all page loads are below 2 seconds.
Measure API response times for critical backend calls.
Verify all API responses return within 500 milliseconds.

title: Security Compliance and Data Encryption
description: Verify encryption of sensitive data in storage and transit, audit logging of critical actions, and enforcement of HIPAA-ready practices.

steps.description: Inspect data at rest for encryption on sensitive fields.
Verify sensitive data is encrypted in database.
Capture traffic during authentication and data transmission.
Verify data is transmitted securely with encryption (e.g., TLS).
Perform sensitive actions such as patient record deletions.
Verify audit logs capture user, action, and timestamp securely.

title: Accessibility Validation Against WCAG 2.1 AA
description: Verify application UI meets accessibility standards including keyboard navigation and screen reader support.

steps.description: Navigate the entire application using keyboard only.
Verify all interactive elements are reachable and usable without mouse.
Use screen reader to navigate pages.
Verify all meaningful content and controls are announced properly.
Verify sufficient color contrast and alternative text on images.

title: Integration Testing of Multi-Module Workflows
description: Verify seamless data flow and functional integration across modules such as client management, appointments, clinical records, billing and communications.

steps.description: Create client and add patient information.
Schedule appointment for patient.
Create clinical record after appointment completion.
Generate invoice for services rendered during appointment.
Send follow-up communication via email or SMS to client regarding billing and care instructions.
Verify data consistency across all modules and successful completion of end-to-end workflow.
